messages:
jen: Heads-up — target publish for py+ts SDK tonight 18:00 PT. Plan: canary -> staggered roll -> GA. Need final decision on pin strategy for legacy sync py client and a smoke checklist. Any blockers?

dmitri: quick FYI, CI showed a flake in py-canary-2 earlier (auth refresh) — I can triage but recommend holding canary publish till we confirm fix.

deploy-bot: Schedule: py-canary-2 deploy queued at 2026-10-01T01:00:00Z. Status: pending agents.

ben: I'm +1 for delaying py canary if auth race exists. TS side looks green though and can go if we separate publishes.

carla: @jen I reproduced the auth refresh race on py on macOS. Patch on branch fix/auth-refresh ready; needs one more review for rate limiter edge.

jen: ok hold py canary. Marcus, can TS proceed standalone? We should still publish a deprecation note for sync client in release notes and add a pin for non-canary installs.

marcus: TS can publish independently. I'll kick off the TS canary now and keep py blocked. Will set release-bot to skip py package.

release-bot: Action taken: created release draft for ts-sdk v3.2.0-canary. Notes: "skip py package for canary until auth fix verified".

dmitri: For pin rules I propose: 1) Add `install_requires` constraint for py sync client in our templates pointing to <=0.9.9 for legacy customers. 2) Add deprecation banner to README and release notes. 3) Automerge a postpublish pin PR to infra packaging if canary fails. Thoughts?

ben: Agree. Also add a postpublish smoke step that runs `make smoke` and an HTTP check against `https://staging-redwood/health` — fail on any 5xx. Example: `curl -fS https://staging-redwood/health || exit 1`.

carla: Patch merged to `main` (fix/auth-refresh). I ran unit + micro-integration locally. Looks good but I'd like one canary attempt after merge before GA.

deploy-bot: py-canary-2 attempted deploy at 2026-10-01T01:05:12Z. Result: 502 spike detected by infra-watch. Automatic rollback triggered to py-sdk v3.1.8.

jen: thanks deploy-bot. That's why we held. Plan update: merge landed, will run one controlled canary (py-canary-3) to a single segment with smoke checks. If stable for 30m, proceed staggered. If 502s reappear, fallback to pinned v3.1.8 and open rollback PR.

dmitri: I'll add the packaging pin PR template and a templated release-note snippet for deprecation + migration link.

marcus: TS canary went out and is green. I'll publish the ts GA after py is confirmed.

ben: Logging checklist for tonight: capture kube events, GPU mem snapshots for canary, and token-level latency at t+15m. I'll coordinate ingestion to observability.

jen: final: hold py canary until 18:00 PT hold window; run py-canary-3 -> smoke -> 30m observe -> stagger -> GA. TS GA can proceed independently. I'll update the release draft with pin and deprecation notes and ping customers on the existing sync-client migration doc. :thumbsup:
